hero.headline: Clinical AI that works with doctors, not around them.
hero.subhead: KONSENXIA is an assistant for medical consultation, differential diagnosis support, and doctor-to-doctor collaboration — with an anonymized learning pipeline designed for KVKK, GDPR, and HIPAA-aligned handling. Architecture-first, roadmap-honest.

problem.title: Clinical knowledge is fragmented; trust cannot be
body: Clinicians consult across colleagues, guidelines, drug references, and records that live in different systems. The cost of that fragmentation is time — and, occasionally, continuity of care.

Introducing AI into that flow raises harder questions: where does patient data go, who can see it, and what is the model actually trained on? Institutions cannot adopt tools whose data path is opaque, and regulators increasingly will not accept "trust us".
problem.audienceNote: Built for clinics and hospitals evaluating clinical AI, for health-tech investors reviewing the category, and for developers integrating or extending the platform.

solution.title: Four design commitments
solution.body: KONSENXIA combines an AI medical consultation surface, doctor-to-doctor channels, an anonymized learning loop, and a compliance posture designed from the first diagram — not retrofitted.

pillars.title: Clinician collaboration
pillars.body: Doctor-to-doctor consultation keeps a licensed human at the centre of every clinical judgement. The assistant drafts; the clinician decides.

pillars.title: AI assistant
pillars.body: Consultation support, differential diagnosis prompts, emergency consult shortcuts, and knowledge-hub retrieval in one surface.

pillars.title: Anonymized learning
pillars.body: An anonymization pipeline is designed so learning signals are separated from direct identifiers. Designed for — not certified — until an audit says otherwise.

pillars.title: Compliance posture
pillars.body: KVKK + GDPR are design goals baked into architecture and docs/legal records; HIPAA-aligned handling is a target posture for deployments that require it.

evidenceStrip.title: Architecture & roadmap posture
evidenceStrip.note: Status: architecture / roadmap unless a source states otherwise. Sources: repo docs/healthcare_ai_architecture.md, docs/legal/*, FAZ_C expert review themes. Full registry: /metrics.

trust.title: Why clinicians and investors take the meeting

items.title: Clinician in the loop
items.body: Every output is decision support. Final clinical responsibility stays with the licensed professional.

items.title: Anonymized by design
items.body: The learning pipeline is architected around de-identification. We describe it as "designed for" — certification claims appear only when audits exist.

items.title: KVKK + GDPR as design goals
items.body: Compliance posture is recorded in docs/legal/* and architecture docs, and labelled architecture — not as a certificate we do not hold.

items.title: Open landing, clinical product
items.body: The site's code is dual-licensed MIT / Apache-2.0. The clinical application and models stay private under agreement.

items.title: Expert review themes
items.body: FAZ_C expert review themes feed the roadmap: safety, explainability, and auditability are tracked as work items, not slogans.
